pairs.subject: budget-reallocation-prescription
pairs.evidence: src/lib/campaigns/budget-moves.ts:146 A burner is detected by ROAS inside the waste-sorted loop that already stops at maxMoves, so the test is not the conversion count and a higher-waste shift can take the last slot before a smaller pause.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/campaigns/budget-moves.ts:181 This skip runs after usedRecipient.add on line 172, so a donor already at the daily floor still consumes the recipient.
src/lib/campaigns/budget-moves.ts:119 A margin in (0, 1] ranks by cost minus gross profit; otherwise line 120 uses cost times (1 - roas/TARGET_ROAS), and the donor filter is unchanged.
src/lib/campaigns/budget-math.ts:84 The first stored micros for a Google budget resource is the one restored.
src/lib/campaigns/simulate.ts:110 The set is low-confidence once any shift exceeds half the donor's stored period spend; a pause share is 0.
src/lib/campaigns/budget-moves.ts:146 ROAS, not the unrounded conversion count, selects the pause, and the cap is applied in waste order rather than pauses-first.
src/lib/campaigns/simulate.ts:189 The supplied multiplier scales the recipient's value and conversions; the donor half above it is unscaled, and a non-positive multiplier reads as 1.

pairs.subject: budget-reallocation-prescription
pairs.evidence: src/components/campaigns/BudgetMoves.tsx:313 The preview always prints a portfolio value-change percentage, including when the projected gain is zero or negative.

techniques.evidence: src/components/campaigns/BudgetMoves.tsx:172 The preview passes periodDays into recommendBudgetMoves, but Propose posts a bare create and draftChangeSet rebuilds the set without periodDays, so the approved amount is not the floored preview.
src/components/campaigns/BudgetMoves.tsx:140 A margin outside (0, 1] is dropped before the recommender runs, and the panel states the margin it kept.
src/components/campaigns/PendingProposal.tsx:137 A set with violations is confirmed only by a second click that passes override true, after the breach sentences are listed.
src/components/campaigns/BudgetMoves.tsx:313 A zero or negative value gain still becomes a lift percentage whenever the portfolio has conversion value.
src/components/campaigns/BudgetMoves.tsx:68 A pause row shows the amount as spend saved and does not print estValueGain.
src/components/campaigns/ProposalProjection.tsx:62 When the set carries no calibration stamp, the approval screen does not say the multiplier is 1 because history is insufficient.
